# Android Police

> Android Police is the leading source for Android news, reviews, guides, and tech coverage spanning smartphones, tablets, wearables, and smart home devices.

Android Police provides comprehensive coverage of the Android ecosystem, including device reviews, breaking news about Google and major manufacturers like Samsung and Motorola, app recommendations, and curated tech deals. The site features content from experienced tech journalists and covers emerging technologies like AI and machine learning alongside traditional hardware reviews.

## Key Topics

- Android
- Google Pixel

## Core Device Categories

- [Phones | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/phones): Central hub for Android phone reviews, comparisons, and coverage.
- [Tablets | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/tablets): Tablet reviews, comparisons, and hardware recommendations.
- [Smartwatches & Wearables | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/wearables): Smartwatch and fitness tracker reviews, including Galaxy Watch.
- [Gadgets | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/gadgets): Gadgets news, reviews, and deals covering wearables and accessories.
- [Accessories | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/accessories): Phone cases, chargers, earbuds, and Android device accessories.

## News & Updates

- [News | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/news): Android Police news hub covering Android, Google, smartphones, and wearables.
- [Operating Systems | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/operating-systems): Android, Chrome OS, iOS coverage with security and feature updates.
- [AI & Machine Learning | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/ai-machine-learning): AI and machine learning news, Gemini, and AI feature coverage.
- [Carriers | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/carriers): Cellular carrier news, deals, and wireless plan coverage.

## Apps & Software

- [Applications | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/apps): Android app reviews, recommendations, security, and privacy coverage.
- [Productivity | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/productivity): Productivity app reviews and Google Workspace integration guides.
- [Utilities | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/utilities): Android utilities, launchers, messaging apps, and system tools.

## Smart Devices & Home

- [Smart Home | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/smart-home): Smart home automation, voice assistants, and device reviews.
- [Smart TV | Android Police](https://www.androidpolice.com/smart-tv): Google TV, streaming devices, Chromecast, and smart TV coverage.
